gloss: truth; the real thing; (prefix) true; genuine

definitions.explanation: Used as a noun for 'the truth' or 'the real essence' of something. Mostly appears in set phrases and formal/literary contexts.
Used as a noun-modifier or prefix meaning 'true' or 'real' — emphasizing that something is the genuine, authentic version. Attaches to many nouns to form compounds.

examples.japanese: {真|しん}を{追究|ついきゅう}する。
{真|しん}の{勇気|ゆうき}とは{何|なに}か。
{彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}の{真|しん}を{理解|りかい}するには{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to understand the true meaning of his words.

examples.japanese: {真|しん}{犯人|はんにん}が{捕|つか}まった。
{真|しん}{冬|ふゆ}の{寒|さむ}さは{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: The cold of midwinter is harsh.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}の{真|しん}の{価値|かち}は{接客|せっきゃく}にあると{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think the true value of this restaurant lies in its service.

notes:
Highly productive as a prefix; rare as a standalone noun in everyday speech. Sense 1 mostly appears in formal/literary or philosophical contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {真|しん}{実|じつ}: truth (the more common everyday word)
- {真|しん}{犯人|はんにん}: true culprit; real perpetrator
- {真|しん}{相|そう}: real state of affairs
- {真|しん}{冬|ふゆ}: midwinter
- {真|しん}{夏|なつ}: midsummer
- {真|しん}{価|か}: true value; real worth

NOTES ON READING:
{真|しん} is the on'yomi reading. The kun'yomi {真|ま} (often written まこと in standalone use) gives a different set of compounds: {真|ま}っ{白|しろ} (pure white), {真|ま}っ{暗|くら} (pitch dark), etc. Context and the following sound usually make the reading clear.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真実|しんじつ}: truth — the standard everyday noun for 'truth'
- {本当|ほんとう}: real; true; truth — colloquial, very common
- {正|せい}: correct; proper — emphasizes correctness rather than authenticity
